verdict.rationale: Databricks documents plugging MCP servers into agent workflows: agents can 'discover, authenticate to, and call managed, MCP Service, and custom MCP servers,' wire up external clients like Claude/Cursor to MCP servers hosted on Databricks, and give agents governed access to third-party tools (Slack, GitHub, Google Drive, etc.) via MCP. Marketplace even lists MCP servers as discoverable/connectable assets, showing a full pipeline for consuming external MCP tool servers. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs and more detail on limitations of the MCP client integration in production.
